t: Aluminium construction. Universal, non-handed, inline espagnolette window handle suitable for timber and most uPVC casement windows. Coordinates with Perfectly Matching range. Ease of operation assured with long lever and ergonomically designed green button with cat's eye strip. Heavy duty sprung latch wedge creating a positive click upon closing. With key deadlocking for security, the key clicks into place when inserted and will remain in place when pivoting the lever. For replacing existing handles the 40mm spindle size is ideal as the slotted spindle allows cropping to 5mm increments.
